description: Quote (order class Quotes, Q- number) of the declared account on the store, optionally in one status; the test reads its number, status, quote date, expiration date and total in Quote History. Read only. KB: Quotes; My Account Quote History.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the quote: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

status.description: Quote status code, normalised (ZnodeOmsOrderState.StatusCode): submitted, approved, canceled, expired or inreview. Left out: any status

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
